Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
July 6, 2010
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: June 10 and June 21 (2)
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report submitting May treasury and investment reports. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting agreement with Neil Miller to provide professional services as the city's Interim Public Works Director. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report submitting amendment to DBE Psomas consultant's service agreement in the amount of $29,876 for water line replacement project and Walnut Street rehabilitation. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report submitting amendment to agreement for IEC Consultants in the amount of $40,000 and contract time extension to Sept. 30, 2010; and amendment to agreement with Leighton Consulting in the amount of $12,000 for construction management and consultant services for the construction of the Cypress Reservoir and Water Production Facility. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
j.
Report submitting contract time extension until September 30, 2011, Change Orders 2 and 3 in the amount of $27,610, Change Order 4 in the amount of $14,740 and Change Order 5 in the amount of $5,200 to Tesco Controls for Cypress Reservoir and Water Production Facility. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Report submitting Change Orders 12 through 16 to SSC Construction's contract in the amount of $390,434.27 for Cypress Reservoir and Water Production Facility.
l.
Report submitting amendment No. 2 to the agreement for legal services with Jenkins & Hogin, LLP to increase the retainer $500 per month, from $7500 to $8000 per month. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
m.
Report submitting recommendation from Public Safety and Traffic Commission to remove red curb on Cypress Street south of PCH. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
n.
Report submitting annual contract with Chamber of Commerce for July 1, 2010 to June 30, 2011. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
o.
Report submitting grant application to West Basin Municipal Water District for a drought resistant demonstration garden. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2010-2 Public Hearing on a city-initiated text amendment to the Lomita Municipal Code amending Section 11-1.76.07 of the City of Lomita Zoning Ordinance to allow nonconforming single family residential uses located within certain commercial areas the ability to rebuild should those uses be 100% destroyed by fire, public enemy, or other natural forces to its original pre-damaged condition. Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
7.
REVIEW OF DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 2003-1 Public Hearing on a review of Development Agreement No. 2003-1 for a 20 unit senior citizen condominium project at 25819-25 Eshelman Avenue in the RVD-1000 (Residential Variable Density) zone. Original Applicant: Peter Fredericksen, 8 Pleasant Hill Drive, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274. Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
8.
LOMITA LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 Public hearing on the proposed assessment for the annual maintenance, operation and servicing of the parkway landscaping along the north side of Palos Verdes Drive North and resolution approving the engineer’s report and confirming the assessment for 2010-11. Presented by Interim Public Works Director Miller.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
9.
PROACTIVE CODE ENFORCEMENT PROGRAM Report reviewing the six month proactive code enforcement pilot program.
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
